NELLAI EMIRATES is an integrated township project by Kings Living Pvt. Ltd., focused on providing planned residential development and a professional customer experience. We are looking for enthusiastic, dedicated and result\-oriented professionals to join our growing team and contribute to the project's success.

* Promote and market the NELLAI EMIRATES Integrated Township project.
* Generate prospective customer leads through direct marketing, digital platforms and referrals.
* Explain project features, plot details, pricing and payment plans to prospective customers.
* Coordinate site visits, customer enquiries and follow\-ups.
* Maintain customer databases, sales reports and daily activity records.
* Support sales targets, marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and business associates.
* Coordinate with management and internal departments for smooth project operatio
